articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, codebases, and audio in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on ARC-AGI-2 over GPT-5's initial release, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a persistent working-memory mechanism that maintains coherent context across sessions up to 1M tokens.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Scientific Reasoning
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored 92.4% on the GPQA Diamond benchmark and demonstrated the ability to autonomously design and validate novel organic synthesis pathways. The model leverages a new mixture-of-experts architecture with 3.2 trillion parameters and a dedicated scientific reasoning module fine-tuned on curated research datasets. Google is integrating it directly into Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform for enterprise research workflows.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI's third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg, SC plant, performing multi-step assembly tasks alongside human workers. The robot features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and an on-board vision-language-action model that allows natural language task reassignment on the fly. BMW reports a 23% increase in line throughput in pilot zones with zero safety incidents over 90 days.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Task Completion in Public Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased Optimus Gen 3 performing a sequence of unsupervised household tasks including laundry folding, dishwasher loading, and table setting with a 94% success rate in a live demonstration. The robot uses an end-to-end neural network trained on millions of hours of simulation and teleoperation data, eliminating hand-coded task planners entirely. Musk indicated limited consumer availability by Q2 2027 at a target price below $25,000.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a formal Constitutional AI Oversight (CAIO) framework that provides auditable, machine-verifiable safety constraints for frontier AI models in high-stakes government and healthcare applications. The EU AI Office announced it will adopt the framework as a reference implementation for compliance with the EU AI Act's requirements for general-purpose AI models. The framework includes cryptographic audit trails and real-time red-team monitoring hooks that third-party auditors can independently verify.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) gate-all-around FET process at its Kaohsiung fab, with Nvidia and Apple as lead customers. The node delivers a 35% power efficiency gain over N2 and enables over 200 billion transistors on a single AI accelerator die using TSMC's latest CoWoS-L advanced packaging. This is expected to power Nvidia's Rubin Ultra GPUs shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced the execution of 1,000 consecutive fault-tolerant logical gate operations with an error rate of 10⁻⁸, crossing below the practical threshold for useful quantum error correction at scale. The achievement uses Quantinuum's latest H3 trapped-ion processor combined with Microsoft's topological qubit encoding scheme. Researchers say this milestone puts a practical 100-logical-qubit quantum computer on track for 2028, with near-term implications for cryptography and materials simulation.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Real-Time Sim-to-Real Adaptive Locomotion
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics debuted the commercial version of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, now featuring a real-time sim-to-real adaptation system that allows the robot to dynamically adjust its gait and manipulation strategies when encountering novel terrain or objects not seen during training. The platform is initially targeting logistics and construction verticals with Hyundai's backing. Early customers report the robot can autonomously navigate unstructured construction sites and carry payloads up to 30 kg across rough terrain.
